    # A colored full-width marker row and a matching partial marker below
    # indicate the vertical stripe to draw in the gap, using the stripe color.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    w=len(g[0])
    marker=None
    for row in g:
        nz=[v for v in row if v]
        if len(nz)==w and len(set(nz))==1 and nz[0] != 2:
            marker=nz[0]
            break
    if marker is None:
        return g
    cols=[i for i in range(w) if g[-1][i]==marker]
    if not cols:
        return g
    # matching marker pixels in the bottom row define stripe column(s); fill
    # empty cells between the top marker row and the horizontal divider.
    top=next(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==marker for x in r))
    divider=next((i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==2 for x in r)),len(g))
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(top+1,divider):
            if g[r][c]==0: g[r][c]=marker+1
    return g
''')
